examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Five objections a buyer raises before signing, each written the way the reader would ask it. Every answer starts closed, so the band opens as a scannable list of questions rather than a wall of prose. A band with no items renders no frame at all.

examples.name: Framed
examples.summary: `framed` makes the band draw its own registration frame, for a page that places it in a column with no frame of its own.

examples.name: Rich answer
examples.summary: The `answer` slot replaces each rendered answer, so an answer can carry a link: here every answer ends on a link to the page that settles it.

examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same content written in a docs page: `DocMarkdown` turns a `<Faq>` tag into a real `Faq`. Braced attribute values are JSON, so a docs author copies them from the props or a page entry and never imports the component.
